rationale: The claude pin routes final failures correctly in the cases the comparison exercised — it excludes issue-added checks from baseline comparison and normalizes durations so shared failures in single-command gates still match, keeps candidate-phase launch faults on the coordinator path, and lets doctor degrade gracefully — leaving only the narrow unpinned receipt-identity gap (F5), whereas codex misroutes amendment typos and test-runner output (F1, F2) and antigravity adds candidate-phase rejections and a duplicated retry pipeline (F3, F6).
